summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ERP Production 'Daily Monitoring Job Progress' board refinements. All new features working correctly: automatic Due Date/Plan Start/Plan Finish fields, new columns (Working Date Target, Actual Working Day, Productivity), SO detail modal with day-by-day worked/idle status, and editable PIC/Remarks with auto-save. Backend API returns all required fields, productivity calculation is correct, FGRN->finished flow works, and all regression tests passed.

notes: Working Date Target = 0 for SO 005200 because due_date is not set on the SO (expected behavior)
Productivity = 0% when working_date_target = 0 (correct calculation per formula)

passed_tests: Backend: GET /production/job-progress returns all new fields (due_date, plan_start, plan_finish, days, working_date_target, actual_working_days, actual_working_dates, productivity)
Backend: PUT /production/job-progress/{so_id} only persists pic and remarks (due_date/plan_start/plan_finish are NOT manual)
Backend: Productivity calculation correct - formula: round(working_date_target / actual_working_days * 100, 1)
Backend: FGRN creation triggers FINISHED status when qty >= SO qty, sets plan_finish to FGRN date
Backend: FGRN deletion reverts SO to PROSES status, clears plan_finish
Backend: Daily Production Report endpoints (create, update, delete, masterlist) working
Backend: FRN endpoints (create, update, delete, list) working
Frontend: Job Progress page displays new columns (Days, Working Date Target, Actual Working Day, Productivity)
Frontend: Due Date, Plan Start, Plan Finish are read-only text (not input fields)
Frontend: PIC and Remarks are editable inputs with auto-save on blur
Frontend: SO detail modal opens when clicking SO number, shows day-by-day worked/idle status with summary chips
Frontend: Daily Report popup input modal works (spreadsheet editor, auto-save, Enter navigation, customer auto-fill from SO)
Frontend: Masterlist filters (month, date, operator, SO) and Export Excel button working
Frontend: FRN page create/list/delete functionality working, customer auto-fill from SO
